chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) pronounced seventy Takbeers upon Hamza, and Ali (peace be upon him) pronounced twenty-five Takbeers upon Sahl ibn Hunayf in your presence. He said: He pronounced five, five (at a time). Whenever the people caught up with him, they would say, 'O Commander of the Faithful, we did not catch up with the prayer upon Sahl.' So he would lay him down and pronounce five (Takbeers) upon him until he reached his grave, having done so five times.

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَة: Takbeer (pronouncing 'Allahu Akbar'), a key component of the funeral prayer
key_terms.سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ: Sahl ibn Hunayf, a companion of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: How many Takbeers did the Prophet and Imam Ali pronounce during funeral prayers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi illustrates the scholarly debate regarding the number of Takbeers in the funeral prayer, contrasting the Prophet’s seventy Takbeers for Hamza with Imam Ali’s twenty-five for Sahl ibn Hunayf. It highlights the practical methodology of Imam Ali, who paused to allow the congregation to join in, thereby demonstrating the flexibility and communal nature of the Sunnah in Shia jurisprudence. This narration serves as a key evidence for those who advocate for more than the standard four Takbeers, emphasizing the virtue of the Ahl al-Bayt's practices.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww exclaimed seventy Takbeers upon Hamzaas, and Aliasws exclaimed twenty five Takbeers upon Sahl Bin Huneyf. Heasws exclaimed five, five (at a time). Every time (more) people came over and they said, ‘O Amir Al Momineenasws! We could not attend the Salaat upon Sahl’. So heasws placed him (his dead body) and heasws exclaimed five (Takbeers) upon him until he ended up to his grave, (having done so five times)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir from who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

The Messenger of Allah in Salah (prayer) for Hamzah said seventy Takbir and ’Amir al-Mu’minin) Ali said twenty five Takbir in Salah (prayer) for Sahl ibn Hunayf. He (the Imam) said, ‘Each time ’Amir al-Mu’minin said five Takbir as new people arrived saying that we did not have a chance to attend Salah (prayer) for him so ’Amir al-Mu’minin would ask to place him on the ground and he (the Imam) say five Takbir until he arrived to his grave.’”
